record.t: Became chief justice on Sept. 30, 2024, after nomination by Gov. Ned Lamont on Sept. 6, 2024.
record.q: Mullins became the Chief Justice on Monday, September 30, 2024, after being nominated by Governor Ned Lamont on September 6, 2024.

record.t: Was sworn in as an associate justice of the Connecticut Supreme Court on November 1, 2017.
record.q: Chief Justice Mullins was sworn in as a Supreme Court associate justice on November 1, 2017.

record.t: Previously served as an Appellate Court judge and a Superior Court trial judge.
record.q: Before his appointment to the Supreme Court, Justice Mullins served as a judge on the Appellate Court and as a trial judge on the Superior Court.

record.t: Was an Assistant State's Attorney in the Appellate Bureau of the Division of Criminal Justice.
record.q: Before becoming a judge, Justice Mullins served as an Assistant State’s Attorney for the Appellate Bureau, in the Division of Criminal Justice.

record.t: Served as an Assistant Attorney General in the Child Protection Division of the Connecticut Attorney General's Office.
record.q: Before becoming an appellate prosecutor, Justice Mullins served as an Assistant Attorney General in the Child Protection Division of the Connecticut Attorney General's Office and tried cases before judges in the Superior Court for Juvenile Matters.
